Ella Wall Pot

3505X
Description The Ella Wall Pot is part of our ArtStone collection of self-watering stone resin planters. Designed for vertical gardening, it brings flowers, herbs, succulents, and trailing plants to walls and other vertical spaces without taking up valuable floor space. Made with ArtStone, a lightweight blend of stone and resin, each planter combines a distinctive marbled finish with the convenience of our built-in Water-Minder® self-watering reservoir. Features: Modern wall-mounted design makes it easy to create vertical gardens and living wall displays Ideal for flowers, herbs, succulents, foliage, and trailing plants Distinctive marbled finish gives each planter a natural, one-of-a-kind appearance Made with ArtStone, a lightweight and durable blend of stone and resin Built-in Water-Minder® self-watering reservoir helps keep plants hydrated while reducing watering frequency Lightweight construction makes the planter easy to position and arrange Built-in keyholes provide convenient mounting, with two mounting screws included Removable drainage plug provides flexibility for indoor or outdoor use Waterproof, frost-resistant, and UV-resistant for year-round versatility Independently verified by Intertek to be made with at least 50% recycled materials and awarded the Intertek Green Leaf Mark Made with BPA-free, recycled materials Dimensions: 5½" = 5½" L x 4¾" W x 6¼" H 8½" = 8½" L x 5¾" W x 7" H 14½" = 14½" L x 6¾" W x 7¾" H For case specs and other info, please refer to our in-depth product overview page.
